card.title: Make It Their Idea
card.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.

mechanism: A tailors an unwanted copying task to B's love of calligraphy and removes the unappealing parts to invite volunteering.
confusable: Unlike merely assigning work, A must make the task personally attractive through B's actual preferences and objections.
comparison: D05-a trades list-reading and aunt management for creative freedom; D05-b trades storage control and protected space for shed sorting.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
